opus.problem: One of the stories hail is best known for is left out: in Joshua 10:11 the LORD threw down large hailstones on the fleeing Amorites, and more died from the hail than by the sword. Smaller details are used in its place, such as the Job storehouses (clue 7) and the flax and barley aside (clue 3). Swap one of those for a Joshua clue.
